subtopics.title: Self-Supervised Pre-training Objective
subtopics.summary: Pre-training uses self-supervision on massive unlabeled text corpora, optimizing the model for text completion rather than conversation, which causes a pre-trained model to talk like a web page instead of a human.

subtopics.title: Data Sources and Output Risks
subtopics.summary: Pre-training data is often indiscriminately scraped from the internet, which can lead the model to produce outputs that are racist, sexist, rude, or factually wrong.

subtopics.title: Pre-training as Parameter Compression
subtopics.summary: Pre-training implicitly minimizes a model's intrinsic dimension, making larger models easier to finetune later with fewer trainable parameters and less data.

subtopics.title: Full Parameter Updates During Pre-training
subtopics.summary: During pre-training, all model parameters are updated, in contrast to inference where no parameters are updated and finetuning where some or all may be updated.
